criteria.text: Notes that the day-8 chromatin accessibility data are the evidence the marker panel has to be read from.

grounding.quote: ATAC-seq at day 8 shows that Prmt7-deficient (Prmt7-KO) cells carry newly accessible chromatin

criteria.text: Uses the newly accessible Tcf7 chromatin in Prmt7-KO cells to conclude that TCF1 is higher than in wild-type cells.

grounding.quote: newly accessible chromatin at the Tcf7 locus

criteria.text: Uses the closed Gzmb chromatin, rather than the larger expansion, to conclude that granzyme B is lower in Prmt7-KO cells.

grounding.quote: closed chromatin at the Gzmb locus

criteria.text: Explains that KLRG1, CD44 and interferon-gamma are unchanged because the premises report no genotype difference for them.

grounding.quote: per-cell interferon-gamma production is the same in the two genotypes
